summary: The bulk of this diff (PROJEXA Drawings/3D, Documents POST, Minutes-of-Meeting CRUD/PDF/AI-intelligence routes, the shared createDocumentRecord upload path, and the veri-meeting-service actor-union refactor) is clean, well-tested (tenant-isolation tests, a real PDF-binary test), consistently gated by requireAuthOrApiKey/requireRoleOrScope, and correctly org-scoped via withTenantContext -- no schema/migration/RLS/auth-guard changes and no .github/workflows touches, so the tier1 classification and low-blast-radius premise hold for those parts. However, the permits GET route rewrite silently renames a field on an already-shipped, documented-stable external contract: the prior response key `expiryDate` (live since 2026-07-14 per docs/API_CHANGELOG.md's own entry for `/api/v1/projexa/permits`, which that same file describes as 'the stable, versioned external contract... reached through the same surface via the /api/v1/projexa/* alias namespace' that PROJEXA itself is built on) is now returned as `endDate` with no backward-compatible alias, which is exactly the kind of breaking change tier1's 'additive / non-breaking' premise is supposed to exclude even though the deterministic path-based classifier can't see it. On top of that, none of this PR's several new /api/v1/** routes or the permits contract change got an entry in docs/API_CHANGELOG.md, despite that file's own explicit instruction to add one in the same PR rather than backfilling later. Recommend holding this diff: either restore `expiryDate` alongside the new `endDate` (or confirm no live PROJEXA consumer reads the old key) and add the missing changelog entry, then resubmit for autonomous tier1 merge.
issues: GET /api/v1/projexa/permits response DTO renames the previously-shipped `expiryDate` field to `endDate` (src/app/api/v1/projexa/permits/route.ts toPermitDto) with no backward-compatible alias, breaking an already-live, documented-as-stable external API contract (docs/API_CHANGELOG.md's 2026-07-14 `bab0a768` entry) that PROJEXA itself depends on -- this violates tier1's implicit 'additive/non-breaking' premise even though the deterministic risk-tier.py path classifier has no way to catch a field-level rename.

No docs/API_CHANGELOG.md entry was added for this PR's new routes (/api/v1/projexa/drawings, /veri-meetings, /veri-meetings/[id], /veri-meetings/[id]/pdf, /veri-meetings/[id]/generate-intelligence, POST /api/v1/documents) or for the permits contract change, despite that file's own stated convention of adding an entry in the same PR.

createDocumentRecord / the permits and drawings POST handlers accept a client-supplied projectId (linkedEntityId) with no check that it references a real project the caller's org actually owns, allowing dangling linked-entity references (low severity -- data stays org-scoped, matches pre-existing convention elsewhere in the codebase, not blocking by itself).
